messages:
Aisha (CSM): Morning — sharing this week's Horizon Labs health snapshot. Quick TL;DR: WoW token -28% for prod, QoQ -12%; 95p latency jump from 120ms -> 340ms after last model swap; spend up 18% month-to-date. Link: https://redwood.internal/dash/horizon
Tom (Solutions Eng): thanks. Any specific routes or models driving the latency?
Aisha (CSM): looks like requests routed to 'gptx-8q' fallback more often after 03/09 due to capacity; error rate went from 0.02% -> 0.5% the same window.
Priya (Onboarding): onboarding tasks for Horizon finished last week, but they still use older prompt set for search scoring — could be causing extra tokens. Reached out to their eng to confirm.
Liam (Telemetry): metrics dump attached by DeployBot below. Basic reads:
```
-- horizon_weekly_snapshot
week, total_tokens, avg_latency_95, error_pct
2026-03-08, 12.4M, 118ms, 0.02
2026-03-15, 8.9M, 340ms, 0.48
2026-03-22, 9.1M, 310ms, 0.42
```
Liam (Telemetry): notice the dip WoW then slight rebound but latency still ~3x baseline.
DeployBot: alert: model-fallback-rate for horizon increased to 14% (threshold 5%) at 2026-03-15T09:12Z :warning:
Tom (Solutions Eng): probable cause: autoscaler hit capacity on dedicated pool and policy routed to cheaper shared variant. Can we confirm routing policy logs?
Liam (Telemetry): pulling routing logs now; snippet: `route=shared_variant model=gptx-8q reason=overcommit score=0.72`
Aisha (CSM): commercial note — spend jump tied to more short-lived retries and fallback tokens. Horizon pushed a spike test earlier this month per notes. Could be regression on client retry logic.
Priya (Onboarding): I'll coordinate enablement touchpoint w/ their eng this week, propose prompt tightness + prefix caching. Any collateral?
Tom (Solutions Eng): send them the "reduce-token-usage" snippet and our caching guide. Quick sample to reduce prefix tokens:
```
// suggestion
cachePrefix(user_id, convo_id)
appendCachedKV() // reduces repeated history tokens by ~30%
```
Aisha (CSM): renewal risk — currently low-medium. If latency and spend stay elevated, risk jumps. I'll flag for AM. Recommend 1) short-term routing cap to avoid fallback 2) enable prefix/KV cache 3) ask Horizon for spike schedule.
Liam (Telemetry): I've scheduled a 24h trace job and will post per-route P50/P95/P99 by EOD.
DeployBot: dashboard snapshot uploaded: /artifacts/horizon_weekly_1777754321.png
Tom (Solutions Eng): pinging infra to see if we can temporarily bump dedicated allocation for Horizon tomorrow AM.
Aisha (CSM): thanks all. Priya — can you set enablement call for Thu 11am PT? I'll include cost/latency slides.
Priya (Onboarding): on it, sending invite now.
Aisha (CSM): also capturing feedback: Horizon asked for clearer alerting when fallback happens — logged as request #CS-412.
Tom (Solutions Eng): noted. I'll draft a small alert doc + runbook.
Aisha (CSM): closing notes: action items — (1) Liam: route traces + P95 by EOD; (2) Tom: temp capacity ask; (3) Priya: enablement invite; (4) Aisha: renewal flag + customer comms. Back to you if anything else. :thumbsup:
